name: hrm-system
description: Multi-tenant HR + Payroll + Attendance SaaS platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin,mobile -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health -t 60000 && npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 -t 120000 && npm run dev:admin" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 -t 120000 && node scripts/start-mobile.js"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hrm/shared-types && npm run build -w @hrm/api && npm run build -w @hrm/admin && npm run build -w @hrm/web
